svg.title: When may a provisional ghost row paint?
svg.desc: A ghost is bookkeeping by default. It paints only after it is orphaned, unsuperseded, not owned by a live turn, newer than the committed tail and not shaped like a short sidecar reply.
svg.text: When may a provisional ghost row paint?
session-runtime/ghosts.ts lifecycle and ghostPredicate.ts · Claude and Codex, OpenCode ghosts never paint

svg.title: When may a provisional ghost row paint?
svg.desc: A ghost is bookkeeping by default. It paints only after it is orphaned, unsuperseded, not owned by a live turn, newer than the committed tail and not shaped like a short sidecar reply.

svg.text: Blue: Agent Code · Gray / dashed border: external · Amber: checks and cautions
Arrow: state change; its label is the trigger. Filled dot: starting state.
